evidence: Running evaluate.load on the local rouge metric with identical Nepali prediction/reference strings returns rouge1/rouge2/rougeL/rougeLsum of 0.0 by default, while passing tokenizer=str.split returns 1.0 for the same inputs.
steps: Install the local evaluate package from codebase/ together with rouge_score, absl-py, and nltk.
Load the local rouge metric from codebase/metrics/rouge.
Compute scores for identical Nepali prediction/reference strings with the default tokenizer.
Observe all ROUGE scores are 0.0, then rerun with tokenizer=str.split and observe all scores become 1.0.
